author: Vineeth Kartha
name: vin_generate_tags
description: Generates tags and a title for a photo using a locally installed Ollama AI model (gemma3:4b).
description-extensive: Uses a locally installed Ollama AI model (gemma3:4b) to automatically suggest tags and a title for a photo. It requires Ollama and the gemma3:4b model installed on your computer.
